meta.title: Rural Bank of Hermosa (Bataan), Inc. | Mobile Banking App
meta.description: Official mobile banking app of Rural Bank of Hermosa (Bataan), Inc. — secure, convenient digital banking.

hero.subhead: Secure, convenient, and fully digital banking for the communities we serve — anytime, anywhere.

paragraphs: At Rural Bank of Hermosa (Bataan), Inc., we are committed to being one of the leading rural banks in Bataan by upholding the values of trust, responsibility, and integrity while delivering accessible financial solutions and exceptional customer service.
We strive to foster lasting relationships with our clients, support community development, promote sustainable growth, and maintain full compliance with regulatory standards and good governance.

Through professional excellence, continuous learning, and a dedicated workforce, we aim to provide reliable banking services that contribute to the success of our customers and the communities we serve.

privacy.label: Legal & Data Privacy
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Rural Bank of Hermosa (Bataan), Inc. is committed to protecting the privacy and security of the information you share with us.

sections.heading: 1. Who we are
sections.body: Rural Bank of Hermosa (Bataan), Incorporated is a rural bank licensed by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) with principal office at Burgos St., Poblacion, Hermosa, Bataan. We operate the Rural Bank of Hermosa (Bataan), Inc. mobile banking app available on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. For questions about this policy, contact us at compliance@rbhermosa.com.ph.

sections.heading: 2. What data we collect
sections.body: Account data (name, date of birth, government ID, address, contact details); Transaction data (transfer records, payment history, balance inquiries); Biometric data (facial image and liveness check, collected during eKYC enrollment for identity verification only — not retained after the verification session); Device data (device model, OS version, unique device ID — for fraud prevention only); Usage data (session logs, feature interactions, error reports); Location data (approximate, only if permission is granted — used to verify transactions). We do not collect data from your contacts, camera, or microphone unless you separately grant permission for a specific feature.

sections.heading: 3. How we use your data
sections.body: To open and maintain your account and EPFS enrollment; to verify your identity via eKYC (biometric facial matching and liveness detection); to process and record transactions; to conduct AML/KYC compliance checks, including PEP screening and sanctions screening, as required by the Anti-Money Laundering Act; to prevent fraud and unauthorized access; to comply with BSP regulations and other applicable Philippine laws; to send transaction notifications and security alerts; to improve the app based on anonymized usage patterns.

sections.heading: 4. Data sharing
sections.body: We do not sell your personal data. We share it only on a strict need-to-know basis with: Higala Technology Philippines, Inc. (technology provider — processes customer account records and transaction data in encrypted cloud storage); RCBC (clearing and settlement bank — receives settlement-level transaction data only, not account balances or personal details); Veriff (eKYC provider — processes biometric data for identity verification during enrollment only; data not retained after the session); Amazon Web Services, Inc. (cloud infrastructure — hosts encrypted data on behalf of Higala; does not access customer data for its own purposes); BancNet, Inc. (ACH operator — receives transaction routing data for InstaPay clearing only); regulatory authorities (BSP, AMLC, NPC) as required by law; courts and law enforcement on valid legal process.

sections.heading: 5. Data retention
sections.body: We retain personal and transaction data for a minimum of 10 years as required by BSP regulations and the AMLA. Biometric data collected during eKYC is not retained beyond the identity verification session unless required by law. After the applicable retention period, data is securely deleted or anonymized.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights (RA 10173)
sections.body: Under the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173), you have the following rights with respect to your personal data: Right to be Informed — be told what data is collected, why it is processed, and with whom it is shared; Right to Access — request a copy of your personal data and information on how it has been processed; Right to Rectification — request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data; Right to Object — object to processing for purposes other than those you consented to, particularly for direct marketing; Right to Erasure / Blocking — request deletion or blocking of data that is no longer necessary or was unlawfully processed, subject to the Bank's legal retention obligations; Right to Data Portability — request your personal data in a machine-readable format for transfer to another controller, where technically feasible; Right to Damages — seek compensation for damages caused by inaccurate, incomplete, or unauthorized use of your personal data; Right to File a Complaint — file a complaint with the National Privacy Commission (NPC) at complaints@privacy.gov.ph or www.privacy.gov.ph. To exercise any of these rights, contact the Bank's Data Privacy Officer at dpo@rbhermosa.com.ph.

sections.heading: 7. Security
sections.body: We protect your data using AES-256 encryption for data at rest and TLS 1.2 or higher for data in transit. Application logs are masked to remove personally identifiable information. Access to cloud infrastructure is governed by multi-factor authentication (MFA) and role-based access controls. The platform undergoes regular penetration testing and independent security audits.

sections.heading: 8. Children's privacy
sections.body: The app is intended for users 18 years of age and older. We do not knowingly collect data from minors. If you believe a minor's data has been submitted, contact us immediately.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time. When we do, we will post the updated version here and revise the effective date above. Continued use of the app after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

sections.heading: 10. Contact us
sections.body: Rural Bank of Hermosa (Bataan), Incorporated | Burgos St., Poblacion, Hermosa, Bataan | Email: support@rbhermosa.com.ph | Phone: 09859700110 | Data Privacy Officer: dpo@rbhermosa.com.ph

deletion.label: Account & Data
deletion.heading: Request Account or Data Deletion
deletion.intro: You may request the deletion of your Rural Bank of Hermosa (Bataan), Inc. mobile banking account and the personal data associated with it. Please read the information below before submitting your request.
deletion.whatItMeans: Deleting your account will permanently remove your access to the Rural Bank of Hermosa (Bataan), Inc. mobile app. Your bank account itself remains open unless you separately visit a branch to close it. Transaction records are retained for a minimum of 10 years as required by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) and the Anti-Money Laundering Act (AMLA).

steps.title: Settle any pending transactions
steps.body: Ensure no pending transfers, bills payments, or loan obligations are tied to your app account.

steps.title: Submit your request
steps.body: Request the deletion of your account and personal data using either of the following methods:

methods.title: Email us
methods.body: Send an email to support@rbhermosa.com.ph with the subject "Delete My Account". Please send it from the email address registered to your app account so we can verify your identity.

methods.title: Visit a branch
methods.body: Go to any Rural Bank of Hermosa (Bataan), Inc. branch and request account or data deletion in person. Please bring a valid government-issued ID.

steps.title: Deletion completed
steps.body: Once verified, your app account and non-regulated personal data will be deleted within 15 business days. A confirmation will be sent to your registered email.
